title: Holiness of God
definition: The Holiness of God means God is perfectly pure, set apart from all evil, and glorious in all His ways.
summary: The Holiness of God means God is perfectly pure, set apart from all evil, and glorious in all His ways.
christFocus: Jesus reveals God's holiness without distance from sinners: He is the sinless Son who draws near, bears sin, and makes unholy people clean by His blood.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content:
God’s holiness means He is utterly set apart from all that is sinful, corrupt, common, or unworthy. He is pure in all His being, perfect in all His ways, and glorious beyond every creature.

Scripture shows that God’s holiness is not cold distance but radiant purity. His holiness exposes sin, humbles pride, awakens worship, and teaches His people that He must be approached with reverence.

Christ reveals the holiness of God without hiding the mercy of God. At the cross, the Holy One did not ignore sin; He dealt with it through the sacrifice of His Son so sinners could be cleansed and brought near.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content:
A shallow view of God makes sin seem small and worship seem casual. The holiness of God awakens reverence by reminding believers that the Lord is not like us, not ruled by our desires, and not shaped by the standards of a fallen world.

This doctrine also gives hope to people ashamed of their sin. God’s holiness does not mean the unclean must hide forever; it means cleansing must be real. In Christ, the holy God makes a way for sinners to be forgiven, washed, and welcomed.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Approach God with reverence rather than casualness. Let His holiness expose what needs repentance, deepen your worship, and lead you to Christ for cleansing. Ask the Holy Spirit to form holy desires in you so your life increasingly reflects the God who has called you out of darkness.
